title: Retry handler resends a POST after the server has already accepted it
body:
<!-- Thanks for reporting a bug! Please fill in the sections below. -->

### Description

When a POST times out on the client after the server has processed it, the retry handler sends the same request again, so the server creates a duplicate record. Idempotent verbs are fine; only non-idempotent requests are affected.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Configure the client with a 1 second timeout and three retries.
2. Point it at a server that sleeps 2 seconds before answering a POST.
3. Send one POST and count the records the server created.

### Expected behavior

A POST is retried only when the connection failed before the request was sent; one request creates exactly one record.
